description: Modified residues that are a cofactor bound covalently to the protein, mapped to that cofactor's CCD ID. A residue listed in _pdbx_struct_mod_residue (mmCIF) or MODRES (PDB format) adds its cofactor to the cofactors. Proposed by researchers on 2026-10-28 and approved on 2026-10-29; a new pair needs their approval. See docs/cif-extraction.md.
